description: Named variables of the SplitHead's behaviour (chara/SplitHead/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: split_head_blood_alpha
fields.note: Opacity of the blood strands between the jaws; fades while the body lies dead.

fields.name: split_head_prev_rot_y
fields.note: rot_y of the previous tick: a turn twists the body.

fields.name: split_head_steer_angle
fields.note: The heading the circling states steer to (the free ray towards Harry).

fields.name: split_head_walk_time
fields.note: anim_time of the walk cycle on the previous tick (201 when not walking): a wrap is a step.
